Demo viewer

The in-page demo viewer. Switch it on for your own account to check demos by hand, or for everyone once you are happy with it. The pilot tools for approving and qualifying individual demos are kept below, closed, because the viewer no longer depends on them.

Open demos in the viewer on RepoShelf

This applies to your account only. Visitors, and you with this switched off, still get demos in a new tab. Every demo opens this way, whether or not it has passed qualification, and the viewer labels it “Unqualified preview”. Use it to check demos by hand; the daily qualification job is the automated check. Demos that cannot be framed, or that are on RepoShelf itself, open in a new tab.

Open demos in the viewer for everyone

This applies to every visitor, signed in or not, and works the way your own switch above does: every demo that can be framed opens in the viewer as an unqualified preview. Demos that forbid framing, cannot be reached, or are on RepoShelf itself open in a new tab. “Open in new tab” and Close are always available in the viewer. Switch it off and every “Try demo” opens in a new tab again. Visitors pick up a change within about a minute.

Pilot toolsGlobal switch, approving demos, pilot demos and qualification

Global switch

While off, every demo opens in a new tab. A change reaches an open viewer within about a minute.

Choose from chromium, chromium-mobile, webkit, webkit-mobile and firefox (Firefox has no mobile emulation). Any profile that has failed keeps a demo external until it passes again or you clear it.

Add or update a demo

Actions: click, fill, press, waitFor, expectVisible, expectText, expectPopup, expectDownload. A scenario needs at least one interaction and one expected result. Loading the page is not enough. The result must be checked after the last interaction.

Pilot demos

A demo opens in the viewer only when it is approved, not disabled, and its latest qualification passed within 48 hours for its current address and settings. Anything else opens in a new tab.

    Qualifying

    A scheduled job qualifies the approved list every day, once for each profile. Scenarios are stored with a revision history, and editing a scenario or address makes earlier results stop counting. Keep passwords and tokens out of scenarios. Demos that need a provider login stay external. To try one demo from a terminal:

    node scripts/viewer-qualify.mjs --url=https://demo.example/ --scenario=scenario.json [--popups] [--downloads] [--browser=chromium|webkit|firefox] [--mobile]

    Repeat manual checks on real Safari and real devices after significant demo or viewer changes. Qualification shows a demo can work; it cannot guarantee every visitor's session.
